const axios = require('axios')

async function snapfromSoundCloud(trackUrl) {
  const api = 'https://snapfrom.com/wp-json/aio-dl/video-data/'

  const payload = new URLSearchParams()
  payload.append('url', trackUrl)
  payload.append('token', 'a2ae81fd2b441b9cb462ca2612f1f0b6147c986b873f3b9f7bda8b3f3437b235')

  const res = await axios.post(api, payload, {
    headers: {
      'accept': '*/*',
      'content-type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
      'origin': 'https://snapfrom.com',
      'referer': 'https://snapfrom.com/soundcloud-music-downloader/',
      'user-agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 6.0; Nexus 5 Build/MRA58N) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/142.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36'
    }
  })

  const data = res.data
  if (!data || !data.medias) {
    return { code: 400, message: 'Gagal mengambil data dari SnapFrom' }
  }

  return {
    code: 200,
    timestamp: Date.now(),
    data: {
      title: data.title,
      duration: data.duration,
      source: data.source,
      thumbnail: data.thumbnail,
      url: data.url,
      audios: data.medias
        .filter(m => m.audioAvailable)
        .map(m => ({
          quality: m.quality,
          extension: m.extension,
          size: m.formattedSize,
          download: m.url
        }))
    }
  }
}
